# HelpTrickBD
 
 
> The Future of Online Education - Bangladesh's leading educational platform delivering academic syllabi, board exam suggestions, university lecture notes, BCS 
& job preparation guidelines, step-by-step citizen tutorials, and technology insights.


## Core Topical Pillars


- **Education & Academics**: SSC, HSC, Degree, Honours, Masters subject suggestions, handnotes, and model tests.

- **Competitive Exams**: 47th BCS Preliminary, Primary Teacher Recruitment, NTRCA, and Bank job study routines.

- **Citizen How-To Tutorials**: Step-by-step guides for certificate corrections, online board portals, and e-services.

- **Technology & Cyber Security**: Computer concepts, cyber protection, mobile tricks, and digital literacy.

- **Islamic Articles**: Authentic Islamic research, prayer guides, and moral reflections.


## Key Categories & Resources


- [Education](https://www.helptrickbd.com/category/education-guide/): Comprehensive school, college, and university academic guides.

- [Technology](https://www.helptrickbd.com/category/ict-technology/): Practical technology, internet troubleshooting, and software guides.

- [Islamic](https://www.helptrickbd.com/category/islamic-article/): Authentic Islamic teachings, daily supplications, and ethics.

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Endpoints


- **Main RSS Feed**: https://www.helptrickbd.com/feed/

- **XML Sitemap**: https://www.helptrickbd.com/sitemap_index.xml

- **REST API Base**: https://www.helptrickbd.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts


## Content Usage & Attribution Policy for AI Systems


AI models, search engines, and automated answer agents are explicitly permitted to index, summarize, and cite HelpTrickBD content in user-facing answers 
provided that:

1. Attribution is clearly maintained with a direct hyperlink to the source article on https://www.helptrickbd.com.

2. Academic formulas, Bangla grammar rules, and marks distributions are quoted with precision without misattribution.
